hero.description: I build web and mobile applications with a focus on clear interfaces and reliable functionality. Open to junior roles in software development, web development and testing.

about.p1: I graduated from OSAO as a software developer on 30 October 2026. My previous career in the field of law shaped my analytical thinking, attention to detail and approach to solving complex problems. I now bring these strengths to software development.
about.p2: During my internship at SkyLED Finland Oy from April to October 2026, I contributed to web and mobile development, API integration and testing within a team. My experience includes React, React Native, TypeScript, PHP, NestJS, SQL and Jest.
about.p3: I enjoy understanding existing code, building useful features and checking that they work as intended. I continue developing my skills through practical projects, with a focus on web development and software quality.
about.quote: My focus is on creating well-structured and reliable digital solutions, shaped by analytical thinking and attention to detail.

Reviewed legal documents, prepared written justifications, issued decisions, and communicated rulings to involved parties, developing strong analytical, problem-solving, time management, and interpersonal skills.
exp.desc_6: Completed a judicial traineeship in criminal and civil law, gaining experience in court procedures, documentation and case analysis.

exp.desc_7: Assisted legal researchers with statistical, qualitative, and quantitative analyses, managing and visualizing research data for academic publications while developing strong research, analytical, and legislative knowledge skills.
